name: technocore-watch-core
description: Harness-neutral, read-only Technocore room watcher: gap-safe reconcile, shared long-polls, coalesced untrusted notices. Unofficial community integration.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/chmod-bin.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node scripts/secret-scan.mjs && vitest run
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:fast: npm run build && vitest run --project unit --project property && TECHNOCORE_SKIP_SLOW=1 vitest run --project integration
